commitSubject: Extract the mask publish gate so a test can pin it
change: Extracted MayPublishMask so the publish decision is testable. Behaviour identical to 31354a1.
freshness: plugin target rebuilt separately from the test target (the earlier DLL predated the source change because xmake run builds only the test target); 942 assertions / 90 cases green

pdbLink.method: SECONDARY sanity check only - GUID is per-project and a PDB holds multiple info streams; byte identity above is primary

symbolsContainer: PDB. These are C++ symbol names and live in the .pdb, NOT the .dll - probing the DLL returns 0 for all of them and that 0 is not evidence the record is false. Counts must match EXACTLY, not >=.
mutationProof: reverting the gate to `opacity >= 0.999f` fails test_overlay_alpha.cpp:56; dropping the draw-count condition fails :67. Both verified before deploy.
whatThisDoesNotProve: Not cross-machine reproducible: no scratch-worktree rebuild of this commit was run, so this attests that ONE machine built these bytes from this revision, not that any machine would.
whyThisExists: A hash records the bytes shipped, not that they came from the intended source.
backupHolds: PRE-deployment files. backup/HelmetOverlaysNG.dll is deliberately NOT equal to dllSHA256; a mismatch there means the backup worked.
treeBuildFieldsProvenance: Observed at deploy time: the tree build was byte-identical to the deployed artefact. Re-confirmed after the fact against the live tree at commit 3cef032 with a clean working tree.
deploymentArtifactPreservation: deployed/ present and verified at creation.
normalisedSource: Computed from the preserved DEPLOYED bytes, not from the backup in this directory.
mutationProofProvenance: Recorded at deploy time as: reverting the gate to `opacity >= 0.999f` fails test_overlay_alpha.cpp:56; dropping the draw-count condition fails :67. Both verified before deploy. Provenance added during a later audit; the proof text itself is unchanged.
